dataset.method: Udhëzim i përbashkët nr. 4, datë 12.9.2025, of the Minister of Infrastructure and Energy and the Minister of Finance, Fletorja Zyrtare nr. 177/2025, in force on its publication on 2 October 2025: the tariff for using the Llogara tunnel (Shtojca I, with VAT): high vehicles with 2 axles ALL 350, with 3 axles ALL 500, with 4, 5, 6 or 7 and more axles ALL 5000. Trucks over 3.5 t are taken to be high vehicles (the instruction gives no height). Excluding 20% VAT. Charged per passage, either way, at the middle of the tunnel's way in OpenStreetMap. Prepaid (subscription) tariffs aren't modelled; vehicles carrying dangerous goods may not use the tunnel.
